user.title: Welcome to Home Status
user.description: Choose a starting point. Recommended works for most homes and every setting can be changed later.

data.setup_profile: How would you like to begin?

data_description.setup_profile: Recommended enables the complete experience. Essentials starts with the most common household information. Custom lets you choose each information source now.

sources.title: Choose your information
sources.description: Select the kinds of household information Home Status should organize. You can change these later.

data_description.enabled_providers: Choose the providers that should contribute notifications and awareness.

weather.title: Choose your weather source
weather.description: Home Status found more than one weather provider. Weather is only one part of the whole-home awareness experience.

data_description.forecast_entity: Select the weather entity Home Status should use for forecasts.
data_description.include_nws_alerts: Include official alerts when an NWS alert entity is available.

summary.title: Home Status is ready

init.title: Home Status settings
init.description: Choose what Home Status monitors and how it appears.

general.title: Updates & History
general.description: Choose how often Home Status checks for updates and how much information it keeps available.

data_description.refresh_interval: Time between update checks. Recommended: 60 seconds.
data_description.history_retention_days: How long resolved alerts and completed events remain in recent history.
data_description.max_recent_items: Maximum completed events available to the card and timeline.
data_description.max_upcoming_items: Maximum upcoming schedules and reminders available to the card.
data_description.max_insight_items: Maximum patterns and helpful observations Home Status keeps available.

information_sources.title: Information Sources
information_sources.description: Choose what Home Status may show. Checked sources are enabled. Ready means compatible information was found. Enabled sources without Ready stay quiet until configured. Ready now: {detected}.

data_description.enabled_providers: Turn each type of household information on or off. Home Status does not monitor every discovered entity automatically.

news_sources.title: News Sources
news_sources.description: Choose the RSS or Atom feeds Home Status uses for news. {summary}.

data_description.news_source: Select an existing source to edit it, or add a favorite feed.

news_source.title: Configure a News Source
news_source.description: {mode}. Home Status reads the feed directly and displays its newest items in the Notification Center.

data_description.enabled: Turn this source on or off without losing its settings.
data_description.name: A friendly name such as Local News or Space.
data_description.url: Use the publisher's direct RSS or Atom feed address beginning with http:// or https://.
data_description.icon: Optional Material Design icon, for example mdi:newspaper.
data_description.refresh_minutes: How often Home Status checks this source. Five minutes is the minimum.
data_description.max_items: How many recent headlines this source may contribute.
data_description.remove_source: Permanently remove this source from Home Status.

review.title: Review changes

experimental_sensors.title: Add & Configure Entities
experimental_sensors.description: Start with a small reviewed setup, use the broader recommended setup, or configure an entity yourself. Home Status monitors nothing until you apply a selection.

data.starter_profile: How would you like to start?
data.recommended_categories: What types should Recommended Setup include?
data.capability_mode: What should Home Status watch for?

data_description.remove_entity: Search the entities currently monitored by Home Status, then choose one to stop monitoring.
data_description.starter_profile: Quick Start recommends doors, windows, and safety sensors. Recommended Setup also includes motion and connectivity. Custom Setup lets you choose any entity.
data_description.recommended_categories: Choose only the categories you want to review. Camera health and motion are separate choices. Nothing is monitored until you submit the review.
data_description.capability_mode: Recommended configuration uses the entity's Home Assistant metadata. The simple trigger creates an event when the entity exactly matches a state you choose.
data_description.capability_entity: Search by the entity's name or ID. Nothing is monitored until you configure it.

starter_preview.title: Review {profile}
starter_preview.description: These recommendations use Home Assistant metadata, not entity names. Review the checked entities, then submit to start monitoring only those entities.

data_description.starter_entities: Uncheck anything you do not want. You can edit every setting later.

remove_entity.title: Remove {entity}?
remove_entity.description: This stops Home Status from monitoring this entity. It does not delete or change the original Home Assistant entity.

experimental_sensor.title: Set Up {entity}
experimental_sensor.description: Choose what Home Status watches for and how it presents alerts from this sensor. Temperature and humidity use thresholds in {unit}.

data.trigger_state: Create an event when the state equals
data.complete_states: States that mean the cycle completed
data.idle_states: States that mean the appliance is idle
data.alert_behavior: When should it return to the main ticker?
data.trigger_delay_seconds: Alert only after the condition lasts (seconds)
data.retention_minutes: Keep in the footer after it clears (minutes)
data.remove_sensor: Remove this sensor from Home Status

data_description.low_threshold: Create an event only when the value falls below this limit.
data_description.high_threshold: Create an event only when the value rises above this limit.
data_description.display_name: Leave blank to use the automatic alert title. This does not rename the Home Assistant entity.
data_description.trigger_state: Enter the exact Home Assistant state that represents the condition you want shown.
data_description.appliance_type: Sets the appliance icon; it does not limit which entity may be selected.
data_description.complete_states: These values produce a completed-cycle event when the appliance stops running.
data_description.idle_states: These values end a cycle without reporting it as completed.
data_description.remaining_entity: If available, Home Status adds its remaining time to the running-cycle details.
data_description.active_message: Leave blank to use the selected sensor's visible name with a maintenance alert.
data_description.resolved_message: Leave blank to use the selected sensor's visible name with a completion message.
data_description.icon: Optional Material Design icon, for example mdi:dishwasher-alert.
data_description.alert_behavior: One-time activity appears briefly once. Other choices return to the main ticker while the condition remains active.
data_description.display_route: The recommended default shows new alerts in the main area briefly, then keeps them in the bottom ticker.
data_description.trigger_delay_seconds: Prevents brief connection or startup flickers from becoming alerts. Use 0 for immediate alerts.
data_description.publish_current: Off by default. Turn on only if you want the normal reading published continuously.
data_description.alert_when_active: When enabled, an open door or window, or active motion sensor, also creates an alert.
data_description.retention_minutes: How long completed events stay in the footer. This is saved separately for each sensor.
data_description.remove_sensor: Stops Home Status from monitoring this sensor. It does not change the original Home Assistant entity.

navigation.title: Open Pages When Tapped
navigation.description: Choose what opens when you tap information in the Notification Center.

data.navigation_enabled: Open pages when I tap notifications

data_description.navigation_enabled: Open a related page when available.
data_description.navigation_schedule: Choose the page for calendar events.
data_description.navigation_sprinklers: Choose the page for watering schedules and rain delay.
data_description.navigation_waste: Choose the page for garbage and recycling collection.
data_description.navigation_cameras: Choose the page for camera status and live views.
data_description.navigation_family: Choose the map or location page for your household.
data_description.navigation_lighting: Choose the page where exterior lights can be checked and controlled.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Control how information is shown on your dashboard.

data_description.hero_rotation_seconds: How many seconds each main item stays visible.
data_description.media_enabled: Show photos and other rich media when available.
data_description.collapse_repeated_events: Combine similar notifications into one item.
data_description.deduplicate_by_entity: Hide repeated notifications from the same source.
data_description.enable_insights: Show helpful suggestions based on recent activity.

weather.title: Weather & Schedules
weather.description: Configure forecasts, alerts, sprinklers, and collection days.

data_description.include_nws_alerts: Include official National Weather Service alerts.
data_description.include_sprinkler_schedule: Include the next scheduled sprinkler watering.
data_description.include_waste_collection: Include upcoming trash and recycling collection.
data_description.forecast_entity: Choose the weather service used for forecasts.
data_description.weather_preview_condition: Temporarily preview a weather visual. Leave blank to use live weather.

customize.title: Customize Notifications
customize.description: Change how an individual item appears in Home Status.

data_description.override_entity: Select an item only if you want to customize it.
data_description.provider_override: Choose the category shown for this item.
data_description.label_override: Set a friendly name for this item.
data_description.icon_override: Set the icon shown for this item.
data_description.priority_override: Choose how important this item is.
data_description.reset_override: Remove the saved customization for this item.

advanced.title: Advanced Settings
advanced.description: Tools for troubleshooting and advanced customization.

data.refrigerator_door_delay_minutes: Alert When a Refrigerator Door Is Open For
data.refrigerator_temperature_delay_minutes: Alert When Temperature Is High For

data_description.refrigerator_door_delay_minutes: Minutes a refrigerator or freezer door may remain open before Home Status alerts you.
data_description.refrigerator_temperature_delay_minutes: Minutes a high temperature must continue before Home Status alerts you.
data_description.refrigerator_fridge_high_temperature: Alert when the refrigerator remains above this temperature.
data_description.refrigerator_freezer_high_temperature: Alert when the freezer remains above this temperature.
data_description.navigation_custom_weather: Only used when Weather is set to Custom Page (Advanced).

data_description.max_upcoming_items: Maximum number of upcoming reminders to display.
data_description.max_insight_items: Maximum number of insights Home Status keeps available.

data_description.include_healthy_status: Display reassuring messages when your home is operating normally.

data_description.deduplicate_by_entity: Prevent the same event from appearing multiple times.
data_description.enable_insights: Display helpful suggestions based on recent activity.

data_description.include_sprinkler_schedule: Include the next scheduled sprinkler watering.
data_description.include_waste_collection: Include upcoming trash and recycling collection.
data_description.forecast_entity: Choose the weather service used for forecasts.
data_description.override_entity: Select an entity to change how it appears in Home Status.
